description: [Signal Desk] The signal and its drivers stored for a past date (the newest reading on or before it). For questions like 'what did the model say in June'; falpha_signal_desk_performance covers a date range. Requires a connected fAlpha account.

as_of_date.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD, on or before today. The signal stored for that date is returned.
as_of_date.title: As Of Date

horizon.description: Holding period the reading is for, in trading days: hp5d (5), hp15d (15), hp2m (42, about two calendar months).
horizon.title: Horizon

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: falpha_signal_desk_history
title: Signal on a past date
